Image Creator Online 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Generate AI images or videos from text prompts or uploaded files (JPG, PNG, WebP, MP4 up to 200MB)
- Seamless cloud GPU processing delivers 1080p MP4 outputs in 20–40 seconds
- Automated session setup and anonymous token acquisition (100 free credits, 7-day expiry)
- Supports workflows for generating, uploading, editing, and exporting video/image content
- Clear error feedback and robust handling for upload, credit, and export operations
- Tailored for marketers, content creators, and social media managers needing fast, server-side image and video generation
